title: Correct gravitational force
description: Essential: Student must correctly calculate the gravitational force on the object in the rocket as 4 N.

title: Correct height calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly determine the rocket's height above ground as 6400 km.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: Student must apply Newton's second law to relate normal force, gravitational force, and acceleration in the rocket.

title: Inverse square law application
description: Important: Student must correctly apply the inverse square law of gravitation to relate forces at different distances from Earth's center.

title: Mass determination from ground force
description: Important: Student must correctly determine the object's mass from the given gravitational force on the ground.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units throughout calculations, especially converting km to m when needed.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns sign to the rocket's acceleration relative to gravity.

title: Confusing force with pressure
description: Pitfall: Student misinterprets the given 'pressure' as something other than normal force exerted by the object.
